title: Our Future Health — Genetic ancestry data — Ancestry estimation metrics — warning checks
description: Non-blocking checks for the ancestry_estimation_metrics table, from plausibility ranges the source does not state (D127). A finding is a warning for analysts and data providers: it never rejects a row and never changes data. Run tools/warn.py; the main schema and tools/validate.py are unaffected.
